message.content: The layout is well-optimized for mobile, with clear visual hierarchy and appropriate spacing that makes the content easily scannable on a 390px screen. There is no visible overflow or cut-off text—all elements including the heading, description, QR code, and data sharing details are fully contained within the dialog. The design appears clean and professional, using a consistent color scheme (green for branding/security), clear typography, and logical grouping of information. The inclusion of a session timer, scannable QR code, and explicit data sharing disclosure enhances both usability and trustworthiness for an identity verification flow.
